items.title: Charlie Bocage Interview, 1960-07-18
items.q: You know, Paul Barbaran, I think. He came back and told him that he could get and wake up there.

ctx.x: He died in 1930, I think. He was here and things were pretty rough here in the music business. You know, Paul Barbaran, I think. He came back and told him that he could get and wake up there. He was just crying for a man of his type. And he and my sister, they packed up and left. And that was the last I saw of him. I saw him when they brought him back, his body back. Where's he buried at? Where's he buried at? He buried in the St. Louis Cemetery. I guess when he is here.
Did he have a good reputation as a clarinetist in town?
